subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` change its existing automatic fresh-session fallback after an unrecoverable ambiguous Gateway disconnect to fail closed by default, requiring `--rerun-on-ambiguous` for a new embedded run?
rationale: The patch’s recovery mechanics are bounded and proof-backed, but the default changes what existing CLI users receive after a disconnect and how `--deliver` workflows trade duplicate side effects against no local result.

options.title: Preserve the current fallback default
options.body: Keep automatic fresh-session fallback as the compatibility default and stage reattach-first or fail-closed behavior behind an explicit option until product direction is confirmed.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed recovery
options.body: Accept the compatibility change so unrecoverable ambiguous runs return an error by default, with explicit rerun consent for users who accept duplicate-effect risk.

options.title: Choose a mode-specific policy
options.body: Use reattach-first for all runs but retain automatic fallback only for selected interactive or delivery modes with documented behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current fallback default
recommendation.body: Keep automatic fresh-session fallback as the compatibility default and stage reattach-first or fail-closed behavior behind an explicit option until product direction is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged abnormal-close fallback implementation establishes the current behavior whose user contract this PR changes.
